title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2611.19244v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $\tau^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $\tau^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. translated_title: 智能体式在线策略蒸馏隐式地重塑大语言模型的ReAct模式
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）能够将专业化能力迁移给语言模型智能体，但其对交互行为的跨领域影响仍不清楚。我们研究了OPD如何在数学、ALFWorld和τ²-bench三个环境中重塑ReAct交互模式，重点关注推理、动作和观察获取三个方面。通用推理监督使数学任务中的工具尝试比例从70.4%降至14.4%，同时将准确率从16.7%提升至38.0%；代码解释器监督则改善了家庭任务动作和零售查询表现。相比之下，ALFWorld监督使τ²-bench准确率从41.5%降至6.6%，并伴随着频繁违反用户信息依赖关系的工具调用。为了仅利用源域训练轨迹来应对这种负迁移，我们探索了一种由领域特定强化学习前后教师偏好变化所引导的选择性OPD方法。保留前95%的token位置可将τ²-bench准确率从11.5%提升至29.9%……
tldr: 该研究揭示了在线策略蒸馏会隐式重塑大语言模型智能体的ReAct交互模式，跨域迁移既可能带来增益也可能引发负迁移，并提出基于教师偏好变化的选择性蒸馏方法，仅用源域轨迹即可有效缓解负迁移。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that on-policy distillation implicitly reshapes LLM agents' ReAct interaction patterns across domains—yielding both gains and negative transfer—and proposes teacher-preference-guided selective distillation that mitigates negative transfer using only source-domain trajectories.
